lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is tightest at the shoulder and rump, with wider gaps in the central ribcage area.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 6th line from the anterior, splitting into a Y-shape near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 4, 8, and 11 exhibit truncation or dashed fragmentation along the lower ventral-lateral border.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch, grouped in a triangular formation.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-thigh show horizontal alignment, forming a short geometric segment parallel to the ground plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns are short, straight, and conical, protruding at approximately a 40-degree posterior angle from the skull; no lyrate curvature is present.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.20 of the distal horn length displays high-contrast ivory coloration compared to the dark base.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes and two distinct white circular spots on the cheek/buccal area.
